pending.data-pointer-bounds-remapping-form: PENDING positive source plan using p(0:2) => one-dimensional target storage where C1019 and later remapping semantics are separately satisfied.

review_rationale: batch107: independent fresh-context source review against pinned J3/24-007 (sha256 7371e889...). Reviewer read all 32 base units of 10.2.2.1 and 10.2.2.2 in the original PDF rather than the author summary, verified 32 base / 61 fine units, 29 requirements and 92 facets (all pending), and independently confirmed the accounting claim that only 5 base units are newly accounted. The 27 numbered items R1034 through R1041 and C1016 through C1034 were already accounted by the numbered-rule inventory; the newly accounted units are 10.2.2.1 p1 and p2 plus 10.2.2.2's unnumbered note, p1 and p2. No double count and no dropped unit were found, and using the numbered identifiers as requirement IDs rather than minting S identifiers matches suite_data enforcement and earlier batches. The zero-permissions claim was independently adjudicated and accepted: the only two latitude words in scope are both the word can, and neither grants the processor a choice. In 10.2.2.1 p2 it identifies another execution route by which pointer assignment occurs, namely a derived-type intrinsic assignment statement, and in the 10.2.2.2 note it describes an admitted program shape. No requirement was demoted and no permission promoted. 10.2.2.2 p1 and p2 are correctly dispositioned as definitions: p1 says data-pointer-object and proc-pointer-object denote the pointer object while data-target and proc-target denote the pointer target, and p2 defines those terms for derived-type intrinsic assignment; neither carries a shall or an independent obligation, and no normative obligation was lost. The reviewer audited the 32-row attribution table required by project precedent, spot-checking C1018, C1019, C1020, C1021, C1023, C1026, C1028, C1030, C1031, C1032 and C1033 against the source, including every constraint that yields two or more negatives, and confirmed each negative is individually attributable to one prohibiting clause. Pointer-specific discipline was verified: no plan reads, compares, dereferences, invokes or inquires about a pointer whose association status is undefined, ASSOCIATED is proposed only after another cited source establishes defined status with 16.9.20 kept as an explicit dependency, and no bounds oracle is asserted without nondefault bounds to avoid vacuity. Decision: source-eligible, no blocking findings; three non-blocking observations recorded in doc/source_audits/batch_107.json. This registers source accounting only: it is not fixture approval, it supplies no execution, and it approves no oracle.
